svg.title: How Vocello works
svg.desc: The Mac app, the iPhone app and the vocello command line each host the same engine in-process. The engine store admits a take and owns cancellation and memory policy; the VocelloQwen3Engine actor runs the talker, the code predictor and the speech decoder on MLX and Metal; audio streams chunk by chunk to the live preview, a limiter, an atomic WAV writer with an AudioSeal watermark and an audio check, and only then to History.
